items.title: 防止 AI 人才外流，OpenAI 调整薪酬政策
items.raw_excerpt: 12月14日，据《华尔街日报》报道，OpenAI 在刚刚过去的一周告诉员工，该公司将取消一项薪酬政策。该政策规定员工在公司工作至少六个月后才能获得股权归属。这六个月就是所谓的“归属悬崖”。如果 OpenAI 员工在六个月内离职，任何股票都拿不到。（IT之家）

title_i18n.zh: 防止 AI 人才外流，OpenAI 调整薪酬政策
title_i18n.en: To prevent the outflow of AI talent, OpenAI adjusts its compensation policy.
title_i18n.es: Para evitar la fuga de talentos en IA, OpenAI ajusta su política salarial.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 12月14日，据《华尔街日报》报道，OpenAI 在刚刚过去的一周告诉员工，该公司将取消一项薪酬政策。该政策规定员工在公司工作至少六个月后才能获得股权归属。这六个月就是所谓的“归属悬崖”。如果 OpenAI 员工在六个月内离职，任何股票都拿不到。（IT之家）
excerpt_i18n.en: On December 14, The Wall Street Journal reported that OpenAI informed its employees in the past week that the company would eliminate a compensation policy. This policy required employees to work at the company for at least six months before their equity would vest. This six-month period is known as the "vesting cliff." If OpenAI employees leave within six months, they receive no stock. (IT Home)
excerpt_i18n.es: El 14 de diciembre, según informó The Wall Street Journal, OpenAI comunicó a sus empleados la semana pasada que eliminará una política salarial que establecía un período de adquisición de derechos sobre acciones de al menos seis meses tras incorporarse a la empresa. Este período de seis meses se conoce como "precipicio de adquisición". Si un empleado de OpenAI dejaba la compañía antes de esos seis meses, no recibiría ninguna acción. (IT Home)

items.title: I built an AI that scans 10k Reddit comments to find 'Blue Ocean' ideas
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN,
I dropped out of college 3 months ago to solve my own problem: I kept building SaaS products that nobody wanted.
I realized I was guessing instead of measuring. So I built a system to automate "Market Signal Detection" using LLMs.
The Architecture:
1. Ingests data primarily from Reddit (niche communities), Hacker News, and rising Search Queries.
2. Filters for "Negative Sentiment" + "Financial Pain" (e.g., people complaining about losing money).
3. Calculates a "Velocity Score" to spot trends before they hit mainstream Google Trends.
I wrote a detailed technical breakdown of the methodology and the "3 Signals" I look for (Bleeding Neck, Fragmentation, Wallet Index).

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, the 20th China IDC Industry Annual Conference (IDCC2025) and Digital Infrastructure Technology Expo (DITExpo) were held in Beijing. Lin Hai, General Manager of the Intelligent Computing Center of SenseTime's Big Device Business Group, delivered a keynote speech titled "From Stable Assurance to Efficiency Leadership—SenseTime Big Device's Innovative Practices in Computing-Power Synergy." Lin Hai pointed out that globally, computing infrastructure is entering a new round of strategic competition in "computing efficiency," with major tech giants continuously improving computing efficiency through self-developed AI accelerators, data center liquid cooling, and renewable energy power synergy. Meanwhile, platforms such as Palantir's "Chain Reaction" integrate computing power scheduling, power prediction, and chip resource management into a unified system, attempting to build a "national-level AI infrastructure operating system." As a leading AI infrastructure in China, SenseTime Big Device's exploration in computing-power synergy offers a systematic design that provides a Chinese paradigm for "computing-power—energy" collaborative construction, aiming to secure technological initiative for China in the next phase of AI infrastructure competition. Industry Leadership: Global Advancement of "Computing-Power—Energy" Synergy Marks the Beginning of a New Era of Competition. Lin Hai mentioned that recently, the well-known U.S. big data company Palantir Technologies Inc. (NYSE: PLTR) officially launched a product named "Chain Reaction," positioning it as "an operating system for U.S. artificial intelligence infrastructure."
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, se celebró en Pekín la vigésima edición del Gran Evento Anual de la Industria China de IDC (IDCC2025) junto con la Exposición de Tecnología de Infraestructura Digital (DITExpo). Lin Hai, director general del Centro de Computación Inteligente del Grupo de Negocios de Grandes Instalaciones de SenseTime, pronunció un discurso titulado "De la garantía estable al liderazgo en eficiencia: prácticas innovadoras de colaboración entre computación y electricidad en las grandes instalaciones de SenseTime". Lin Hai señaló que, a nivel global, la infraestructura de capacidad computacional está experimentando una nueva ronda de competencia estratégica en "eficiencia computacional", incluyendo a los principales gigantes tecnológicos que mejoran continuamente la eficiencia computacional mediante el desarrollo propio de aceleradores de IA, la refrigeración líquida de centros de datos y la colaboración con energía renovable, así como iniciativas como "Chain Reaction" de Palantir.

items.raw_excerpt: I've been working on a personal project recently, rewriting an old jQuery + Django project into SvelteKit. The main work is translating the UI templates into idiomatic SvelteKit while maintaining the original styling. This includes things like using semantic HTML instead of div-spamming, not wrapping divs in divs in divs, and replacing bootstrap with minimal tailwind. It also includes some logic refactors, to maintain the original functionality but rewritten to avoid years of code debt.
